info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Managed Content API
Salesforce Experience Cloud List CMS Delivery Channels

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns a list of managed content delivery channels available to the context user. Channels are destinations where content is published for delivery to Experience Cloud sites or external applications.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Delivery Channel

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

items.docs: Returns details about a specific managed content delivery channel including its name, type, and available content types.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Query Channel Content

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: The developer name of the managed content type to query (e.g., news, cms_image, cms_document)

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to filter content (e.g., en_US)

params.name: contentKeys
params.description: Comma-separated list of content keys to retrieve

params.name: managedContentIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of managed content IDs

params.name: topics
params.description: Comma-separated list of topic names to filter by

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs for media content

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns published managed content versions for the specified delivery channel. Supports filtering by content type, language, and content keys. Used for headless content delivery to Experience Cloud sites and external applications.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Search Channel Content

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to find matching content

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Filter search results by content type

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to filter results

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Searches published managed content in the specified delivery channel using a search term. Returns matching content with relevance scoring.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Content Item from Channel

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: contentKeyOrId
params.description: The content key or managed content ID

params.name: language
params.description: Language variant to retrieve

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

items.docs: Returns a specific published managed content version from the specified delivery channel by content key or managed content ID.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Query Community Managed Content

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Content type developer name to query

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to filter content

params.name: topics
params.description: Comma-separated list of topic names

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns published managed content for the specified Experience Cloud site. Similar to channel-based delivery but scoped to a specific community context.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Search Community Managed Content

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site

params.name: q
params.description: Search term

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Filter by content type

params.name: language
params.description: Language code

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Searches published managed content within the specified Experience Cloud site using a search term.
